text:
Sasha: Quick heads-up  planning a smaller rolling maintenance in euc1 tomorrow 01:30-03:00 UTC. Objective: soft GPU reboots + driver warm patches on pool-euc1-C. ~12 racks (~96 GPUs) targeted, will do staggered 2-rack batches. Need pre-seed + spill guardrails.
Priya: Ack. What spill budget are we comfortable with?
Sasha: Target spill ~30% of active sessions. Thats ~29 GPUs. Add 30% buffer -> aim to warm ~38 GPUs.
Ben: Cost check: if we burst to us-west, rough price is ~$1.4k/hr for the needed capacity. Not ideal but doable if we avoid handing traffic to eu-central during their power test.
Marco: eu-central is running a minor power test 03:00-03:45 UTC, might pull out ~8 GPUs at the tail. We should avoid routing to eu-central after 02:40.
Sasha: Good catch. Plan: start 01:30, pause after batch 3 (~02:05) for 12m validation, continue if metrics green. Stop using eu-central as a target after 02:40 and push remaining spill to dedicated-us-central.
Priya: Add a short pause after every 2 racks, not 3. Keeps blast radius smaller.
Sasha: OK change to 2-rack batches, 8m observe windows. We'll also enable conservative batching on serving and switch some heavy routes to model-small variants preemptively.
Ben: Preseed idea: run a lightweight KV prime and a short synthetic traffic replay 45m before. I can run a job at 00:50 UTC. Script: `./tools/prime_kv.sh --pool=dedicated-us-central --keys=150k --rate=2000/s`
Marco: Ill update the routing policy to prefer local-euc1 if latency <300ms, else fallback to us-central. We'll also tag noninteractive routes for token-throttling (-20%).
Claire: Ops-checklist:
1) Seed @00:50, 2) traffic-replay @01:00, 3) cordon+drain 2 racks starting 01:30, 4) observe 8m, 5) continue or rollback.
Sasha: Draining snippet (dry-run first):
```
for node in $(cat nodes-to-drain.txt); do
  kubectl cordon $node
  kubectl drain $node --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=90 &
  sleep 30
done
```
Priya: Metric ask: please emit `evac_spill_gpus` and `route_shift_rate`. Alert if evac_spill_gpus >50 or route_shift_rate spikes >15% within 5m. Auto-pause drain if either fires.
Ben: Agree. Also add a dashboard panel for per-pool p95 and token throughput.
Marco: Failover sequence: 1) prefer dedicated-us-central, 2) then us-west3 (only before 02:40), 3) last resort burst to us-west.
Sasha: Rollback conditions: p95>420ms for >5m, evac_spill_gpus>50, or any unhandled pod evictions. If rollback, run: `./ops rollback-drain --pool=pool-euc1-C --restore-weights` and resume when green.
Claire: I'll prepare customer comms and note degraded SLO for noncritical routes.
ops-bot: Scheduled: maintenance-window: euc1 2025-09-09T01:30Z-03:00Z by Sasha. Task: staggered-drain pool-euc1-C. Ticket: MW-3571. Runbook: github.com/redwood-inference/runbooks/pull/801.
Priya: Thumbs-up. One more: keep a list of hot nodes to skip (NVMe wear) and don't reboot those.
Sasha: Will paste node skip list in the runbook. Final: seeds @00:50, replay @01:00, 2-rack batches +8m observe, throttle noninteractive -20%, abort if evac_spill_gpus>50. Everyone OK?
Ben: OK from infra.
Marco: OK from routing.
Claire: OK from comms, will monitor status page.
Sasha: Thanks team  will post final go/no-go 60m before window.
